articles.title: SAVE SALONE Launches Community Digital Literacy Programme
articles.excerpt: A new initiative is helping young people and community members develop practical digital skills.
articles.content: SAVE SALONE has launched a community digital literacy programme designed to improve access to practical technology skills. The programme focuses on young people, teachers and community members who want to improve their digital literacy and use technology more effectively.
articles.author: SAVE SALONE Communications Team

articles.title: Communities Join SAVE SALONE Tree Planting Campaign
articles.excerpt: Local communities are taking action to restore degraded areas and promote environmental protection.
articles.content: Communities across Northern Sierra Leone are participating in a tree planting campaign aimed at promoting environmental awareness and sustainable land management.
articles.author: SAVE SALONE

articles.title: Women Farmers Receive Sustainable Agriculture Training
articles.excerpt: Women farmers are receiving practical training in sustainable farming and agricultural entrepreneurship.
articles.content: The programme provides women farmers with practical knowledge in sustainable agriculture, farm management, food production and small agricultural enterprises.
articles.author: SAVE SALONE Agriculture Team

articles.title: Community Health Awareness Campaign Reaches Rural Communities
articles.excerpt: SAVE SALONE continues to promote preventive healthcare, sanitation and healthy community practices.
articles.content: The community health awareness campaign is helping families understand the importance of hygiene, sanitation, preventive healthcare and early access to health services.
articles.author: SAVE SALONE Health Team

articles.title: Human Rights and Legal Education Sessions Held for Communities
articles.excerpt: Community members participate in sessions focused on rights, responsibilities and legal awareness.
articles.content: The sessions provide accessible information about fundamental human rights, civic responsibilities and available legal support mechanisms.
articles.author: SAVE SALONE Legal Education Team

articles.title: SAVE SALONE Expands Community Partnership Network
articles.excerpt: The organization is strengthening partnerships with communities and local stakeholders.
articles.content: SAVE SALONE is expanding its network of community organizations, institutions and development partners to increase the reach and sustainability of its programmes.
articles.author: SAVE SALONE

events.title: Community Environmental Awareness Workshop
events.description: A practical workshop focused on environmental protection, climate awareness and sustainable community practices.

events.title: Youth Digital Skills Training
events.description: Practical digital skills training for young people interested in technology and employment opportunities.

events.title: Community Agriculture Forum
events.description: A community forum bringing farmers and stakeholders together to discuss sustainable agriculture.
